verdict.rationale: GitCafe states that repositories work with any Git client over SSH, which implies SSH-based authentication. Its CLI also 'sets up Git credentials', though the evidence never says that means SSH keys. No evidence shows how a developer adds, manages or revokes SSH keys. Missing for 10: documented SSH key upload/management flow (account settings or CLI), key types/fingerprints guidance, deploy keys, and independent or hands-on confirmation that SSH key auth works.
